name: remove-edges
description:
The characters to cut from the edges of each word (remove only).

start: characters cut from the start of a word, any run of them.
end: characters cut from the end of a word, any run of them.

Characters inside a word stay («wi-fi»); a word of only those characters disappears. The result has single spaces, none at the edges.

Example: semkit read --text "!диван! кресло?" remove-edges --start "!" --end "!?" write -
-> диван кресло

remove-edges removes what the matcher finds from the working column.

options.name: --start
options.description: characters cut from the start of a word, any run of them.

options.name: --end
options.description: characters cut from the end of a word, any run of them.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
